purpose: Separate normalized input storage layout from SDK batch shape on one fixed official semantic and anchor physical state; no inference about native arithmetic parity

source_facts.claim: SDK output row shape follows hidden_states B; full model config need not change for isolated attention diagnostics
SDK cached and current attention are separate BF16 matmuls, FP32 manual softmax, separate BF16 PV outputs then BF16 add
SDK manual softmax sums full prior bucket plus active width1 separately; do not trim during batch/layout study
SDK current QKV project independently through original column-parallel layers
SDK parallel linear forward uses einsum, not a guarantee of native nn.Linear arithmetic equivalence
None configured reduction dtype resolves to BF16 weight dtype, not default FP32
SDK output projection produces rank-local BF16 result then collective reduce in selected reduce_dtype
CPU mode collective is in-place torch.distributed.all_reduce; use identical rank order and clone fixed partials for separate shape controls
Original token_generation_batches=None means B1 seq_ids alone does not select one row; obtain original B4 getter view and narrow actual physical slot explicitly
SDK RoPE computes frequencies with batched matmul; reuse one B4-generated cos/sin for all variants rather than introduce B1 RoPE arithmetic change
Native reference has one BF16 q/k/v projection per complete weight, combined L+1 cache, native eager attention and one 2048-wide O projection
Native eager uses concatenated dynamic-length QK, FP32 softmax and single PV; B1 SDK is not native eager

shared_scope_limitation: Current normalized input and valid official K/V prefixes plus previous output are equal across arms; full cache padding is not equal. Study only one fixed anchor physical state and do not generalize to other padding layouts.

view_rules.holes: B1 normalized logical input4096bytes; other12288backingbytes remain unselected, never relabelled as input or zeroed
view_rules.mask: Each physical row retains column<position; width stays original bucket, active current token separate
view_rules.rope: Generate original fullB4 SDK cos/sin once per source call; capture real runtime stride/offset, reuse views and verify selected bytes
view_rules.model: Use same full B4 configured model and official rank-local weights; no B1 model/config rebuild, no KV updates
view_rules.native_lengths: Official previous donor has lengthL=position, native current combined cache lengthL+1; SDK retains prior bucket plus separate active1

contrasts.meaning: Same normalized stride, same anchor/cache/bucket/arithmetic; SDK batch extent changes
Contiguous normalized layout held, SDK batch extent changes

staged_projection_reduction_design.status: Specified only; no stage execution wrapper implemented
staged_projection_reduction_design.mandatory_control: Any stage-decomposed reconstruction must reproduce complete corresponding untouched SDK attention output exactly before localization
staged_projection_reduction_design.qkv: Call installed QKV projections on the same official input; compare complete BF16 Q/K/V with native head mapping retained. Local source QKV width2048 held for B4/B1, output widths1024/128/128 fixed per rank.
staged_projection_reduction_design.attention: For independent shape effect fix the same B4-computed post-RoPE Q/K/V bytes, select rows, call installed compute_for_token_gen with identical bucket, mask,full anchor cache. Do not feed differing QKV into this isolation comparison.
staged_projection_reduction_design.output_projection: Fix same B4-computed pre-O attention bytes [4,1,1024]. Compare original local RowParallelLinear._forward_impl B4 vs B1 with same BF16 weight and reduction width1024; compare local partial before all_reduce as well as final.
staged_projection_reduction_design.collective: To isolate reduction tensor-shape effect, hold each rank local partial byte-identical to B4 reference and use cloned B4 or row views through original _rpl_maybe_reduce_output. Both ranks must use identical slot order. Original reduction dtype BF16 stays.
staged_projection_reduction_design.attribution: Record earliest observed differing stage and fixed-input intervention differences; do not claim additive contribution percentages or that first difference alone explains total residual

deferred_separate_studies: Prior-length trimming bucket→L changes softmax/PV reduction width; do separately after primary shape study
SDK split prior/active vs native concatenated L+1 arithmetic; do separately at fixed QKV/caches
Native full2048-wide output projection vs SDK two1024 BF16 partials and BF16 reduction; different arithmetic, not B1 equivalence
